sections.overview: The Ball python, also called the Royal python, is a small python native to West and Central Africa.
sections.identification: Its brown-and-gold pattern is variable; when threatened, it commonly curls into a tight ball with its head protected inside.
sections.habitat: It occurs in savannas, grasslands and open forests, and may shelter in burrows or other ground cover.
sections.diet: It is a constrictor that feeds mainly on small mammals, especially rodents.
sections.behavior: It is mainly nocturnal and generally spends much of its time on or near the ground.
sections.reproduction: Females lay eggs and coil around them during incubation.
sections.ecology: Wild populations are affected by capture for trade and by local habitat change; harvest pressure differs across its range.
sections.conservation: The IUCN assesses it globally as Near Threatened, citing concerns about exploitation and suspected declines in parts of West Africa.
